title: About — Citadel CX
description: Citadel CX is a Canadian company delivering customer support through a team in Lagos and managed infrastructure hosted in Canada.
headline: We started with the security problem.
standfirst: Outsourced support usually works because everybody agrees not to look too closely at how it is delivered. We wanted to build the version that holds up when somebody does look.
placeBody: Citadel CX is a Canadian company based in Calgary, Alberta, and our infrastructure runs in Canadian cloud regions. Our support team is based in Lagos, Nigeria, working from a managed office on company equipment. We say so openly, because you should know where your customer conversations are handled — and because how we deliver the work is the part we are most confident about.

beliefs.title: Say the accurate thing
beliefs.body: It is easy to overstate what an architecture guarantees. We would rather describe our controls precisely and have them survive scrutiny.

beliefs.title: Good support is judgment
beliefs.body: The contacts that matter are the ones no script anticipated. Hiring well and training properly is not an overhead we try to avoid.

beliefs.title: Controls before scale
beliefs.body: The security model came first and the service was built on top of it. That order is harder at the start and much easier afterwards.

closeBody: We are a new company taking on our first clients. If you are weighing support options and want to talk to the people actually building this, that is exactly who you will get.
